run_train_graph_embeddings: run the torchbiggraph training loop with a config file to learn graph embeddings on CPU or GPU
run_train_with_config_file: run the main entry point to start graph embedding training from a JSON config file path
run_train_multi_machine: run distributed graph embedding training by passing a rank argument for multi-machine setups
review_train_coordinator_selection: review the train function to understand how it selects GPUTrainingCoordinator or TrainingCoordinator based on GPU count
test_train_subprocess_init: test the train function with a SubprocessInitializer to register setup callbacks for child processes
